description:
Push-to-talk dictation for Windows that runs entirely on your PC

Hold a key, talk, let go: the text is typed wherever your cursor is, in any app (browsers, chat, terminals, editors, email).
Speech recognition runs locally on the CPU; an optional local rewrite model removes filler words, false starts and self-corrections without changing what you said. No account, no telemetry, nothing uploaded.
English by default, with an opt-in multilingual recognizer covering 25 European languages. Raw dictation is free; Clean mode is free for 2,000 words a week.
Windows 10/11 x64. Unsigned for now: SmartScreen shows "More info -> Run anyway" the first time.
Smart recognition is the recommended Pro default and sends dictated audio to Holdkey's managed Groq transcription endpoint. Local mode stays fully offline and is the automatic fallback if Smart is unavailable.
